scope: Rule relevance, not implementation or publication acceptance. No NotApplicableToCorpus claims without evidence.

rationales.1: Determines or constrains essential relationships, endpoint identity, membership, inheritance, typing, featuring, or structural bounds. Producer/query closure must be proved independently of validator coverage.
rationales.2: Exact graph impact and alternatives are reviewed per witness in authority-blockers.json.
rationales.3: Evaluation can select a canonical specialization target. The structural output remains critical; evaluation dependence is not permission to publish an unknown target.
rationales.4: Projects documentary annotations, text, or an existing member ID; no structural identity, lookup, typing or featuring fact is selected. Canonical source records remain retained.
rationales.5: Determines model-level evaluability; does not choose canonical structural identities or endpoints. Filter population still requires a separate structural applicability proof.
rationales.6: Judges flags, category compatibility, value restrictions or conformance of an already determined graph; does not synthesize or select canonical facts. A concrete unusable graph contradiction remains separately blocking.
rationales.7: Checks the model's completeness assertion. Deferred on a partial staging overlay; explicit strict checking remains available. No source flag is rewritten. Publication producer closure is independently critical.
rationales.8: Checks Integer/nonnegative values of preserved bound expressions; structural bound identities and order are covered separately by deriveMultiplicityRange* and validateMultiplicityRangeBounds.
